_note: The 2005-06 English One Piece CCG (Bandai / Shonen Jump): The Quest Begins, Passage to the Grand Line and six promos. Card list, names, characters and rarities: Card Game Collector (cardgamecollector.com); Gold / Silver split for Passage to the Grand Line: Alternate Worlds' checklist. refUsd: a raw copy's market price, USD, from PriceCharting sold listings (October 2026); "estimated": no raw sales, the median of the set's cards of that bulk price of its rarity (Common $3, Uncommon $5, Rare $8), or a guess from graded sales. foil: the holo foil printing's price (PriceCharting, else twice the card's). Pictures, fetched by fetch_cards.py VINTAGE: scan = a Card Game Collector scan (cgc.chakra42.net/images/one-piece-ccg-2005/<scan>, watermarked), photo = a PriceCharting image id (storage.googleapis.com/images.pricecharting.com/<photo>/1600.jpg), file = a picture that comes with the app (app/<file>); Cards with no good picture yet are left out.
_sealedNote: Sealed prices, USD. The Quest Begins: asking prices for packs ($650-1,500) and PriceCharting's box price. Passage to the Grand Line: real packs ask about $100-140, but its cards' prices make a pack's contents worth about $300 here, so its pack and box are priced from that (game balance, not the market).
